sub_sector.value: video and live social commerce; TV home shopping; home and lifestyle catalogs

product_category.detail: Multi-category assortment across home, fashion, beauty, electronics and accessories, sold through video commerce.

market_position.detail: Broad assortment of mainstream and private-label brands aimed at a wide shopper base.

distribution_model.detail: Sells directly to shoppers via TV networks, streaming, social platforms, websites, apps, catalogs and some in-store destinations.

purchase_frequency.detail: Discretionary general merchandise purchases, often impulse-driven via live shopping.

notes: Market position and product mix rely partly on general knowledge of QVC, HSN and Cornerstone brands.
